name: participant_roles
template:
You are mapping an ontology-style semantic frame. Given an event {event} and one participant type {participant} , list the typical roles that P can play in E.
Roles must be short role-label strings. Prefer 3–8 roles, ordered from most typical to least typical.
Do NOT invent new participants; only roles for P.
Return only JSON with key:
  - {event} (string)
